title: A great day at Sagrada Família
text: A fantastic tour and our guide was wonderful! We spent a great deal of time there and it was a great value for the cost.
author: 805iram

title: Josep with the most-est
text: Fantastic tour with Josep! Very charming and very knowledgeable. He made the Sagrada Familia even more impressive than we expected. 10 stars if I could!
author: Smige247

title: Brilliant tour
text: Amazing experience! Josep was friendly, knowledgeable and clearly passionate about the Sagrada Familia. There is so much detail in the building that we would never have noticed or understood without him. Really glad we decided to do the guided tour rather than visit on our own.
author: timothyrF8253EU

title: Above our expectations
text:
It was an amazing experience with Mel.. 
she was very informative and New a lot of facts about the whole construction of the Sagrada Família above all of our expectations

title: Semi Private Tour of Familia with Mel
text: Our tour with Mel was outstanding she was wonderful and very knowledgeable. She answered our questions and without Mel we would have missed out on so much.

title: Great experience
text: Javi was great, he really made the place come to life. The cathedral itself is magnificent and the tower visit is a must! Highly recommended.
